oe_ely_set_mode_immediate_1337 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_off }
		remove_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_off
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_exile_only }
		remove_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_exile_only
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_mode_immediate_1337 value = 1 }
}

oe_ely_set_mode_off = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_mode_off value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_immediate_1337 }
		remove_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_immediate_1337
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_exile_only }
		remove_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_exile_only
	}
}

oe_ely_set_mode_exile_only = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_off }
		remove_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_off
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_immediate_1337 }
		remove_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_immediate_1337
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_mode_exile_only value = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Dev Panel fast-forward: initialize voyage if needed and jump straight to oe_ely.13.
oe_ely_dev_instant_landfall = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_voyager } }
		oe_ely_init_voyage = yes
	}
	oe_ely_discover_western_med_and_macaronesia = yes
	oe_ely_discover_mid_atlantic = yes
	oe_ely_discover_chesapeake_coast = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_voyage_stage value = 5 }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.13
}

# Country scope. Begin Act I: Project Ark & oe_sit_fourth_odyssey.
oe_ely_init_voyage = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_voyager value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_voyage_stage value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_fleet_morale value = 70 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_provisions value = 75 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_relic_score value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ark_tier value = 2 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_code value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_ely_declined }
		remove_variable = oe_ely_declined
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_aborted }
		remove_global_variable = oe_ely_aborted
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_odyssey_launched value = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Safely adjust fleet morale (clamped 0..100).
oe_ely_add_morale = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_fleet_morale } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_fleet_morale value = 70 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_ely_fleet_morale add = $amount$ }
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_ely_fleet_morale > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_fleet_morale value = 100 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_ely_fleet_morale < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_fleet_morale value = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Safely abort the voyage (only used on immediate_1337 turn-back).
oe_ely_abort_voyage = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_ely_voyager }
		remove_variable = oe_ely_voyager
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ely_exodus_fleet_mod }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_ely_exodus_fleet_mod
	}
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_voyage_stage value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_aborted value = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Claim uninhabited Bermuda as Cape Agios Nikolaos beacon outpost (oe_ely.10 Option A).
oe_ely_claim_bermuda_outpost = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_host
	location:bermuda = {
		discover_location = scope:oe_ely_host
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ownable = yes
				has_owner = no
			}
			change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_host
			add_core = scope:oe_ely_host
			rename_location = oe_loc_agios_nikolaos
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_host = { exists = religion } }
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:greek_culture
					religion = scope:oe_ely_host.religion
					type = pop_type:soldiers
					size = 0.15
				}
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:greek_culture
					religion = scope:oe_ely_host.religion
					type = pop_type:burghers
					size = 0.10
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:greek_culture
					religion = religion:orthodox
					type = pop_type:soldiers
					size = 0.15
				}
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:greek_culture
					religion = religion:orthodox
					type = pop_type:burghers
					size = 0.10
				}
			}
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_ely_bermuda_beacon_mod
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_bermuda_beacon value = 1 }
}

# Old World Evacuation, Chesapeake Pop Seeding & Atomic Safe Exodus (oe_ely.13)
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope. Deduct departing Greek emigrants from Old World cities before handover.
oe_ely_deduct_old_world_pops = {
	every_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { continent = continent:america }
			NOT = { area = area:bermuda_area }
		}
		every_pop = {
			limit = {
				culture = culture:greek_culture
				pop_size > 0.40
			}
			add_pop_size = { value = -0.15 }
		}
	}
}

# Location scope helper: seed 5-estate Greek pops (expects scope:oe_ely_host).
oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:oe_ely_host = { exists = religion } }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = scope:oe_ely_host.religion type = pop_type:nobles size = $nob$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = scope:oe_ely_host.religion type = pop_type:clergy size = $clg$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = scope:oe_ely_host.religion type = pop_type:burghers size = $brg$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = scope:oe_ely_host.religion type = pop_type:soldiers size = $sld$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = scope:oe_ely_host.religion type = pop_type:peasants size = $psn$ }
	}
	else = {
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox type = pop_type:nobles size = $nob$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox type = pop_type:clergy size = $clg$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox type = pop_type:burghers size = $brg$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox type = pop_type:soldiers size = $sld$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox type = pop_type:peasants size = $psn$ }
	}
}

# Country scope. Seed Greek 5-estate pops across Chesapeake bridgehead scaled by oe_ely_ark_tier (1.8k / 3.2k / 5.0k).
oe_ely_seed_chesapeake_pops = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_host
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_ely_ark_tier ?= 3 }
		# Tier 3 (~5.00k total across chesapeake 2.60k, nansemond 1.30k, kiskiack 1.10k)
		location:chesapeake = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.25 clg = 0.25 brg = 0.80 sld = 0.45 psn = 0.85 }
			}
		}
		location:nansemond = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.10 clg = 0.10 brg = 0.45 sld = 0.25 psn = 0.40 }
			}
		}
		location:kiskiack = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.08 clg = 0.07 brg = 0.25 sld = 0.25 psn = 0.45 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_ely_ark_tier ?= 1 }
		# Tier 1 (~1.80k total across chesapeake 0.95k, nansemond 0.45k, kiskiack 0.40k)
		location:chesapeake = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.10 clg = 0.10 brg = 0.30 sld = 0.20 psn = 0.25 }
			}
		}
		location:nansemond = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.04 clg = 0.04 brg = 0.15 sld = 0.10 psn = 0.12 }
			}
		}
		location:kiskiack = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.03 clg = 0.03 brg = 0.10 sld = 0.10 psn = 0.14 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		# Tier 2 (~3.20k total across chesapeake 1.65k, nansemond 0.85k, kiskiack 0.70k)
		location:chesapeake = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.16 clg = 0.16 brg = 0.50 sld = 0.33 psn = 0.50 }
			}
		}
		location:nansemond = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.07 clg = 0.07 brg = 0.28 sld = 0.18 psn = 0.25 }
			}
		}
		location:kiskiack = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.05 clg = 0.05 brg = 0.18 sld = 0.16 psn = 0.26 }
			}
		}
	}
	# Bonus scholars, artisans & Varangian veterans if imperial relics were preserved (relic_score >= 3)
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = oe_ely_relic_score
			var:oe_ely_relic_score >= 3
			exists = capital
		}
		capital = {
			oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.05 clg = 0.08 brg = 0.15 sld = 0.12 psn = 0.10 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Safely detach Old World holdings AFTER capital is verified in America.
# Priority: transfer to TUR (in Balkans/Anatolia) or AI neighbor; abandon_location strictly as fallback.
oe_ely_abandon_old_world = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_host
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			capital = { continent = continent:america }
			any_owned_location = { continent = continent:america }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_code value = 1 }
		# 1. Sever Old World subjects cleanly so no phantom cross-ocean wars drag Nova Elysia back.
		every_subject = {
			limit = {
				exists = capital
				NOT = { capital = { continent = continent:america } }
			}
			save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_old_sub
			scope:oe_ely_host = {
				cancel_subject = scope:oe_ely_old_sub
			}
		}
		# 2. End active Old World wars cleanly and establish 15-year mutual truce with TUR.
		every_current_war = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						attacker_leader = scope:oe_ely_host
						defender_leader = scope:oe_ely_host
					}
				}
				white_peace = this
			}
			else = {
				save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_w
				scope:oe_ely_host = {
					leave_war = {
						war = scope:oe_ely_w
						actor = scope:oe_ely_host
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:TUR
				NOT = { tag = TUR }
			}
			add_truce_with = {
				target = c:TUR
				years = 15
				mutual = yes
			}
		}
		# 3. Transfer Old World locations (preserving America and Bermuda Cape Agios Nikolaos!).
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { continent = continent:america }
				NOT = { area = area:bermuda_area }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:oe_ely_host = {
						num_locations > 1
						exists = capital
						capital = { continent = continent:america }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						country_exists = c:TUR
						c:TUR = { is_ai = yes }
						OR = {
							region = region:balkan_region
							region = region:anatolia_region
						}
					}
					change_location_owner = c:TUR
					scope:oe_ely_host = { change_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n add = 1 } }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						any_neighbor_location = {
							has_owner = yes
							owner = {
								is_ai = yes
								country_type = location
								NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_host }
							}
						}
					}
					random_neighbor_location = {
						limit = {
							has_owner = yes
							owner = {
								is_ai = yes
								country_type = location
								NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_host }
							}
						}
						owner = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_heir }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { exists = scope:oe_ely_heir }
						change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_heir
						scope:oe_ely_host = { change_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n add = 1 } }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						country_exists = c:TUR
						c:TUR = { is_ai = yes }
					}
					change_location_owner = c:TUR
					scope:oe_ely_host = { change_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n add = 1 } }
				}
				else = {
					# Strict fallback: only abandon isolated Old World enclaves when capital is already in America.
					scope:oe_ely_host = {
						abandon_location = prev
						change_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n add = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_code value = 2 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_owned_location = {
					NOT = { continent = continent:america }
					NOT = { area = area:bermuda_area }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_code value = 3 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_code value = 3 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Atomic Safe Exodus sequence (called from oe_ely.13 options A & B).
oe_ely_complete_landfall = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_host
	# 1. Reveal Chesapeake & East Coast waters.
	oe_ely_discover_chesapeake_coast = yes
	# 2. Draw departing emigrants from Old World cities before handover.
	oe_ely_deduct_old_world_pops = yes
	# 3. Claim 3-location Chesapeake bridgehead (chesapeake, nansemond, kiskiack) & rename.
	location:chesapeake = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ownable = yes
				OR = {
					has_owner = no
					AND = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner = { is_ai = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_host
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
			add_core = scope:oe_ely_host
			rename_location = oe_loc_nea_konstantinoupolis
		}
	}
	location:nansemond = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ownable = yes
				OR = {
					has_owner = no
					AND = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner = { is_ai = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_host
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
			add_core = scope:oe_ely_host
			rename_location = oe_loc_chrysokeras_hesperias
		}
	}
	location:kiskiack = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ownable = yes
				OR = {
					has_owner = no
					AND = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner = { is_ai = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_host
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
			add_core = scope:oe_ely_host
			rename_location = oe_loc_chalybopolis
		}
	}
	# 4. SET_CAPITAL_FIRST: promote chosen Chesapeake capital to city and move capital BEFORE Old World handover!
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:oe_ely_capital_choice ?= 2
			owns = location:nansemond
		}
		location:nansemond = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_city = yes } }
				change_location_rank = location_rank:city
			}
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_ely_natural_anchorage_mod
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		set_capital = location:nansemond
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owns = location:chesapeake }
		location:chesapeake = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_city = yes } }
				change_location_rank = location_rank:city
			}
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_ely_breakwater_mod
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		set_capital = location:chesapeake
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owns = location:nansemond }
		location:nansemond = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_city = yes } }
				change_location_rank = location_rank:city
			}
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_ely_natural_anchorage_mod
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		set_capital = location:nansemond
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owns = location:kiskiack }
		location:kiskiack = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_city = yes } }
				change_location_rank = location_rank:city
			}
		}
		set_capital = location:kiskiack
	}
	# 5. Seed Greek 5-estate pops & found native New Constantinople market center.
	oe_ely_seed_chesapeake_pops = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			capital = {
				continent = continent:america
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:oe_ely_host
				NOT = { is_market_center = yes }
			}
		}
		capital = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_mkt_loc }
		create_market = {
			builder = scope:oe_ely_host
			location = scope:oe_ely_mkt_loc
			price = price:oe_ely_free_market_price
			instant = yes
			price_modifier = 0
		}
	}
	# 6. Activate v9.9 Colonization 2.0 Nova Elysia Foederati hook.
	oe_col2_activate_elysia_hook = yes
	# 7. Safely detach Old World holdings (strictly gated on capital in America).
	oe_ely_abandon_old_world = yes
	# 8. Dynamic Country Name & Act I -> Act II State Transition.
	change_country_name = OE_NOVA_ELYSIA
	change_country_adjective = OE_NOVA_ELYSIA_ADJ
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_settled value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_settled_year value = current_year }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_settled_month value = oe_ml_month_now }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_is_elysia value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_voyage_stage value = 6 }
	# Cleanly close Old World oe_l7 siege & Aegean exile guerrilla chains on this host after settling in America.
	set_variable = { name = oe_l7_off value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_l7_ex_reborn value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_ely_voyager }
		remove_variable = oe_ely_voyager
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ely_exodus_fleet_mod }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_ely_exodus_fleet_mod
	}
	add_country_modifier = {
		modifier = oe_ely_nova_elysia_founded_mod
		years = 15
		mode = replace
	}
	# 9. Schedule post-landfall Act I closing milestones (First Winter +6m, Elysian Charter +12m).
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ely.14 days = 180 }
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ely.15 days = 365 }
}

# ==============================================================================
# Slot 72 Monthly Dispatcher (called by oe_mainline_lock or oe_ely_fallback_pulse)
# ==============================================================================

oe_ely_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { oe_ely_rule_is_off = yes }
			is_ai = no
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { var:oe_ely_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_aborted }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }

		# Phase A: Opening Triggers (Immediate 1337 or Exile-Only Crisis)
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_odyssey_launched }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_declined }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					oe_ely_immediate_1337_ready = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_2_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_2_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.2
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					oe_ely_rule_is_exile_only = yes
					oe_ely_old_world_crisis = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_1_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_1_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.1
			}
		}

		# Phase B: Active Crossing Sequence (paced cleanly >= 2 months between legs)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				oe_ely_is_voyaging = yes
				oe_ely_since_last_ev >= 2
			}
			# Stage 1: Fleet preparation (.3 -> .4 -> .5)
			if = {
				limit = { var:oe_ely_voyage_stage ?= 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_3_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_3_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.3
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_4_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_4_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.4
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_5_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_5_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.5
				}
			}
			# Stage 2: Strait of Gibraltar (.6)
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					var:oe_ely_voyage_stage ?= 2
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_6_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_6_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.6
			}
			# Stage 3: Isles of the Hesperides — Azores, Madeira, Canaries (.7)
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					var:oe_ely_voyage_stage ?= 3
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_7_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_7_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.7
			}
			# Stage 4: Sargasso Tempest (.8), optional Mutiny (.9), Bermuda Beacon (.10)
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:oe_ely_voyage_stage ?= 4 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_8_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_8_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.8
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_9_done }
						OR = {
							AND = {
								has_variable = oe_ely_fleet_morale
								var:oe_ely_fleet_morale < 35
							}
							AND = {
								has_variable = oe_ely_provisions
								var:oe_ely_provisions < 30
							}
						}
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_9_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.9
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_10_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_10_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.10
				}
			}
			# Stage 5: Chesapeake Sighting (.11), First Contact (.12), Foundation (.13)
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:oe_ely_voyage_stage ?= 5 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_11_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_11_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.11
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_12_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_12_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_13_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_13_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.13
				}
			}
		}

		# Phase C: Post-Settlement Backup Safety Net (in case delayed events were disrupted across reload)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
				oe_ely_is_elysian_host = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_charter_proclaimed }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_14_done }
					oe_ely_months_since_settled >= 7
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_14_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.14
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = oe_ely_ev_14_done
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_15_done }
					oe_ely_months_since_settled >= 13
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_15_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.15
			}
		}
	}
}
